notes.title: What makes the new IRON GUARD: Salvation special?
notes.content: [h3]Hi! Today we want to share what makes IRON GUARD: Salvation different from the first part and why it has become even better.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/3676c7968b02aeef1d235f5e23601c2c806755de.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Players who have already tried the game on [url="https://www.meta.com/experiences/iron-guard-salvation/5651010038313251/"]Meta Quest[/url] note that it takes everything good from the first game and makes it even better. The graphics and atmosphere are brighter and more vivid, the levels are much more detailed, and each map feels unique and memorable. There’s no sense of generic backdrops or filler.[/p][p]The balance has been completely reworked: now [u]every turret matters and plays its role[/u], each with strengths and weaknesses. The same goes for enemies – each has unique traits, forcing players to plan their defenses more carefully.[/p][p]We’ve also added the ability to move building platforms for turrets to any free spot on the map. This gives players more tactical freedom and allows for new defensive setups.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/a5644979d68815aa3fda45100aa03912df49a0d9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Heroes have now become a full-fledged part of the gameplay. Previously, they were only story characters, but now they can be controlled on the battlefield. Each has passive abilities and an ultimate skill. For some levels, it makes sense to choose different heroes depending on the situation.[/p][p]Another new feature is the player’s drone, which can be made autonomous with a special upgrade. This allows the player to focus entirely on strategy while the drone automatically attacks nearby enemies.[/p][p]By popular request, we added difficulty levels and a more convenient progress tracking system on the map. This helps players better follow their advancement and plan their playthroughs.[/p][p]The game now features bosses – special enemies that can’t be defeated by brute force alone. Each has unique mechanics and weaknesses that need to be understood and exploited. This adds depth and makes these encounters much more intense.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/cba7376c08b252263b73892dffa94d67e4d6656b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Many players note that the game carries the spirit of classic RTS. This comes through in the visuals, music, and voice acting. At the same time, we kept the atmosphere of the first part and added many secrets and easter eggs to make exploration more rewarding.[/p][p]We often hear that the gameplay is incredibly addictive, and our stats confirm that players spend a lot of time in the game. Even those who usually don’t like Tower Defense admit that IRON GUARD: Salvation feels different to them. Many actively compete for leaderboard spots, constantly finding new ways to score higher.[/p][p]It’s especially important to us that players value our feedback loop. We strive to respond to every review and have already implemented many of their suggestions in patches. In turn, players actively help us polish and improve the game, and we are very grateful for that.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/5687dfbe608dd57bd85643ec8141fb6f1fc670d9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As we mentioned before, in October we’ll be focusing on the SteamVR version and preparing a demo for the Next Fest. We’ll be very happy if you add the game to your [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861410/IRON_GUARD_Salvation/"]wishlist[/url] and join the discussion on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/YKhY3ewTfT"]Discord[/url] or [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1861410/discussions/"]Steam forum[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861410/IRON_GUARD_Salvation/" style="button"]Add to wishlist[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your support![/b][/p]

notes.title: We're back with lots of news ahead!
notes.content: [h3][b]Hi there! We're back — and we have some good news ✨[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/00b1941c2fd7ef59d97e8801e34a768a13199a66.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The second patch for the [url="https://www.meta.com/experiences/iron-guard-salvation/5651010038313251/"]MetaQuest Store version[/url] is just around the corner. All critical bugs have been fixed, and there are only a few left. Thanks to Quest players we’ve received a lot of feedback, which helped us not only fix issues but also improve some elements of gameplay and controls. [/p][p][/p][p]Very soon the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest/"]Next Fest[/url] will kick off, and we’ll do our best to participate and prepare a demo. In addition, we’ll now be regularly sharing news about the game: talking about new features, showing gameplay shots, and sharing our plans.[/p][p][/p][p]In [b]October[/b], we’ll be working on porting the game to [b]SteamVR[/b]. So stay tuned, add the game to wishlist, tell your friends, and keep an eye out for updates 🚀[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861410/IRON_GUARD_Salvation/" style="button"]Wishlist now![/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/ae67fba3089944bd80118516ac36593c9e5fa34d.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the world of IRON GUARD: Salvation!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to introduce IRON GUARD: Salvation — a sci-fi VR Tower Defense game with elements of arcade and RTS. Many of you highly appreciated the IRON GUARD universe, and we have worked to preserve its core elements while adding many new features and improvements, many based on your feedback and suggestions. The game is still under active development, and we are striving to make it even more impressive. Let’s give you a brief overview of what’s waiting for you in the new game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335922/00b1941c2fd7ef59d97e8801e34a768a13199a66.gif[/img]

[b]Key Features[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Varied Locations:[/b]
This time, you will experience not just 30 exciting levels, but also journeys to different planets, each with unique challenges, atmospheres, and biomes.

[*][b]Improved Graphics:[/b]
The world, turrets, enemies, buildings, and effects are even more stunning.

[*][b]More Gameplay Elements: [/b]
Improved and new objects like the Harvester, Factory, and Explosive Barrel and many others have been added, providing even more exciting strategic planning opportunities.

[*][b]Heroes with Unique Abilities:[/b]
Command heroes with active and passive abilities that can turn the tide of battle.

[*][b]More Freedom in construction:[/b]
Platforms can now be moved around the level, allowing you to experiment with turret placement, combinations, and tactical approaches.

[*][b]More Turrets and Enemies:[/b]
The variety of turrets has increased, offering unique modifications, while enemies have gained new abilities and tactics, challenging you to adapt and rethink strategies.

[*][b]New Soundtracks: [/b]
Enjoy a powerful and engaging soundtrack that sets the tone for every battle.

[*][b]Drone Enhancements:[/b]
The drone is now more versatile — its shooting has been improved, and new features expand its capabilities.

[*][b]Levels with Environmental Effects:[/b]
Some locations may have positive or negative effects on players and enemies, pushing you to adjust to new conditions.

[*][b]More Bonuses:[/b]
New items from bonus crates will give you tactical advantages and make each playthrough unique.

[*][b]New Perspectives:[/b]
Manage the game’s scale to watch the battlefield from a god-like view or immerse yourself directly into the action.
[/list]

We thank all our players for their support and inspiration. IRON GUARD: Salvation is not just a game; it’s the result of your feedback, ideas, and suggestions. We hope this new project will provide you with unforgettable experiences. The game is still in development, and you have the chance to influence its direction: join our [url=https://discord.gg/YKhY3ewTfT]Discord[/url] server to participate in discussions, share advice, offer suggestions, and follow our updates. We also welcome your ideas on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1861410/discussions/]Steam forum[/url].

Don’t forget to add the game to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861410/IRON_GUARD_Salvation/]your wishlist[/url] and stay tuned for updates. See you on the battlefield!
